FALLOUTMAW.Calendar.Configuration.Client: Client Settings

These are settings that only affect how Fallout-MaW Calendar works or is displayed for this browser. They do not affect any other players. These settings can also be found under the system calendar settings.
Open On Load
Will open up the Fallout-MaW Calendar application when Foundry VTT is loaded.
Open In Compact View
When the Fallout-MaW Calendar application is opened it will open in the compact view by default.
Remember Position
Fallout-MaW Calendar will remember where it was last positioned and place itself there.
Remember Compact Position
Fallout-MaW Calendar will remember where the compact version was last positioned and place itself there when in compact mode. This is a separate position from the full version.
Note Reminder Notification
How Fallout-MaW Calendar will send reminder notifications for notes.
Send a chat whisper with details about the note.
Automatically open the note.
Side Drawer Open Direction
The direction from the main calendar that the side drawers will open. The side drawers contain the calendar list, note list and note search.
Always Show Note List

This setting will make it so the note list will always be visible and can not be closed. The only exception is if the calendar list or note search are opened they will open over top of the note list, but when closed the note list will remain visible.
Persistent Open

When enabled this setting will remove the close button from the calendar window and prevent the escape key from closing it. The button under Journal Notes in the left toolbar then becomes a toggle to open and close the calendar.
Compact View Scale

This setting lets you change the scale at which the compact view is displayed at. You can use this to make the compact view appear larger or smaller. The number represents the percentage of the scale size when compared to the default size, 100%.

FALLOUTMAW.Calendar.Configuration.Title: Calendar Configuration
The built-in calendar provides configurable dates, clocks, seasons, moons, notes, events, reminders, and scene illumination.
This system component is maintained as part of Fallout-MaW and uses only the fallout-maw.calendar runtime namespace.
The original calendar implementation is MIT-licensed work by Dean Vigoren and Arctis Fireblight. Complete attribution and license text are included with the system build.

FALLOUTMAW.Calendar.Configuration.Genera: General Settings
Game World Time Integration
Tell Fallout-MaW Calendar how to integrate itself with the game world time and respond to game world time updates.
None: Does not tie into the game world time.
Self: Control the game world time ignoring updates from other modules.
Third Party Module: Only follows game world time updates from other modules.
Mixed: Update the game world time and follow updates made from other modules.
Pathfinder 2E: World Time Sync
This will force Fallout-MaW Calendar to stay in sync with the built in Pathfinder 2E world time.
This setting has been disabled because the calendar general setting 'Pathfinder 2E: World Time Sync' is enabled.
